lines.en: I show up at the cafe a little earlier than normal and find Rin cleaning the place up before the morning rush.
lines.zh: 我比平时早一点到咖啡馆，发现 Rin 正在早高峰前打扫店里。

lines.en: She says a bunch of confusing things about stuff the closing crew didn't do and I don't really understand any of them.
lines.zh: 她抱怨了一大堆打烊班没做完的事，我一句也没听懂。

lines.en: What I do grasp, however, is that it was likely all Molly's fault that this happened.
lines.zh: 不过我确实搞明白了一点：这事八成全是 Molly 的错。

lines.en: With a bit of prodding, I'm able to get Rin to talk about some more interesting things and we ultimately wind up bonding over none other than girls.
lines.zh: 在我稍稍追问之下，我总算让 Rin 聊起了更有意思的话题，最后我们竟然因为——没错——女孩子这件事拉近了距离。

lines.en: She pulls her phone out and begins showing me a bunch of models she follows on social media and I'm...pretty sure she's even more attracted to them than I am based on her high praise.
lines.zh: 她掏出手机，开始给我看她在社交平台上关注的那些模特，而且……看她夸得那么起劲，我敢肯定她比我还要迷她们。

lines.en: Haruka winds up coming over to break up the conversation but ultimately joins in on the fun.
lines.zh: Haruka 最后过来打断了我们的对话，结果自己也加入了进来。

lines.en: I'm not sure how much time goes by as we do this, but I am sure that I become aroused.
lines.zh: 我不知道我们这样聊了多久，但我确定的是，我起了反应。

lines.en: Our bonding experience is cut short when a group of customers walks through the door.
lines.zh: 一群客人推门进来，我们的交心时刻被迫中断。

lines.en: Rin quickly goes back to cleaning while Haruka mans the counter, and I-
lines.zh: Rin 迅速回去继续打扫，Haruka 站到柜台后面，而我——

lines.en: Well, I get in line to order a coffee.
Having a customer service job must suck.
lines.zh: 干服务行业这活儿一定很惨。
